# LiveKit client

`livekit-client.umd.min.js` is the unmodified browser distribution of `livekit-client` version **2.15.6**, downloaded from the npm package via jsDelivr:

https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/livekit-client@2.15.6/dist/livekit-client.umd.min.js

Upstream: https://github.com/livekit/client-sdk-js (Apache-2.0). See LICENSE in this directory.
